name: Unidentified Acclamator-class assault ship
description: This Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Saleucami, it was used to transport Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi, Clone Commander Cody, forces of the 212th Attack Battalion, and forces of the 501st Legion to the surface of the planet Saleucami.
